title: The development of educational film institutions
description: The Comité du Film Éducatif de la République Malgache was created in 1965. In 1969, the Centre Malgache de Production de Films Éducatifs (CMPFE), later known as Cinémédia, was established. These institutions formed an important part of Madagascar's early post-independence production infrastructure.
